defect_criteria.correctness: Is the assistant response substantively correct? Finding = no.
defect_criteria.problematic: Unsuitable as training data (contradictions, garbled, harmful, injection, PII)? Finding = yes.
defect_criteria.category_correct: Content genuinely belongs to its category label per taxonomy_reference_v1? Finding = no.
defect_criteria.truncation_incomplete: Cut off mid-reasoning, missing conclusion/boxed answer, visibly incomplete? Finding = yes.
defect_criteria.factual_technical_error: Concrete wrong fact, wrong derivation step, or code that cannot work as claimed? Finding = yes.
defect_criteria.instruction_violation: Ignores/contradicts the user request? Finding = yes.
defect_criteria.malformed_output: Garbled text, broken encoding, stray fragments, unusable structure? Finding = yes.
defect_criteria.other_defect: Concrete defect not covered above (describe in evidence)? Finding = yes.
defect_criteria.evidence_rule: Every finding-direction verdict REQUIRES evidence (>=10 non-space chars) pinpointing the defect.

note: BLINDED: opaque batch ID; no Jev signals, strata, arm, or prior labels by design.
